To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the measure of the one-loop nonplanar two-string function is the same as the one-loop planar two-string function, and that the poles of the one-loop planary two-string function are the same as the poles of the tree-level two-string function.

(a) the one loop non-planar amplitude has the same structure as the tree amplitude, (b) the one loop amplitude has a pole at −α′(p2/2−1) and (c) the pole at −α’(p2/4−1) does not appear for the physical states.

we have developed a method to calculate the one-loop amplitudes for Witten's String-Field-Theory, and we have used this method to find that the one-loop two-string amplitude has a pole structure of the form 12n−4, n=0, 1, 2, … with n≠8 k.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the calculation of the quantum effective potential in Witten's string theory.
the study of string field theory in the framework of Witten's formulation of string field theory.
the study of the quantum effective field theory of open strings, as formulated by Witten.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Witten's theory contains only physical open strings and closed strings with mass squared equal to 1/α′.
the only physical poles are those with n=8k, and these are associated with closed string states.
the one loop non-planar two string function is physical and contains the closed string propagator.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have obtained a new and powerful method for calculating one loop amplitudes in Witten's string theory.
the one-loop effective action is given by a sum of one-loop diagrams with an infinite number of poles at −α′ p2=12n, with n≠8 k.

the nonplanar diagrams of the string field theory contain the closed string states, and the closed string states decouple from the open string states in a way consistent with the physical states in the string spectrum.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the measure is a nontrivial object.
the one loop non-planar two string function has a nontrivial structure.
the measure for each diagram can be obtained from a simple path integral.
